statements.quote: Announced strategic expansion into AI-driven HPC hosting with long-term data center leases expected to generate $1 billion in cumulative revenue over initial 10-year contract terms
statements.notes: This is a headline bullet, not a full sentence, and it has no closing period. The $1 billion is cumulative revenue over the initial 10-year lease terms, not a single fiscal year's revenue, so it should not be read as next-year (2025) revenue. The leases start at various dates in 2025 (p03). It is the seller side: HPC/GPU hosting revenue from AI-driven data center leases. The qualitative restatement in p02 ('expected to generate significant recurring revenue') is skipped in favor of this figure.
